strategy.summary: The todo app (public/app.js, purely client-side state served by server.js) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed and clear completed ones. Playwright e2e tests against the real app prove the checkbox toggles strike-through and the "items left" count both ways, each filter shows exactly the right todos and is aria-pressed, and "Clear completed" is shown only while something is completed and removes all completed todos.
inScope: Completing/uncompleting a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All/Active/Completed filters and their pressed state
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; ticket doesn't ask)
assumptions: The real app runs via the existing playwright.config.js webServer (node server.js); nothing is faked. State is in-page memory, so every test starts from a fresh page and creates its own todos through the UI, which makes tests independent.
"Struck through" is asserted as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (the app applies it through li.completed span in styles.css), plus the checkbox's checked state.
The only refusal-like behaviour in scope is that Clear completed is not offered when nothing is completed; the app has no other way to refuse these actions.

risks.description: Count text and pluralisation drift ("1 item left" vs "2 items left")
risks.mitigation: Assert the exact count text before and after toggling.

risks.description: Filter could hide the wrong items or not re-render after a toggle
risks.mitigation: Assert exact list contents per filter with mixed completed/active todos.

risks.description: Clear completed could remove active todos or only one completed todo
risks.mitigation: Clear with two completed and one active todo, assert exactly the active one remains.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed (struck through, items left count decreases by one); unticking reverses both.
Active shows only not-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All shows every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
testCases.expected: Checkbox checked, 'Buy milk' text has line-through, 'Walk dog' does not, count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text not line-through, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed aria-pressed=false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed pressed, others not

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly all three in order; All pressed, others not
testCases.rationale: Returning to All must restore every todo

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
steps: Add 'Buy milk' and assert it is listed
Tick it; assert Clear completed visible
testCases.expected: Hidden with no completed todos, visible with one, hidden after unticking
testCases.rationale: Visibility rule including the 'not offered' case

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog'], '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Must remove all completed, not just one, and keep active ones

strategy.environmentNotes: Uses the existing playwright.config.js webServer (node server.js on port 4173, baseURL http://localhost:4173). Browsers must be installed (npx playwright install chromium).
